body:
**Starts** once #125 is merged.

## Why

The coordinator writes its replies in Markdown, such as **bold** labels and numbered lists. The browser chat (#52) shows each reply as plain text, so the user sees the raw marks, such as `**Trip brief**`. It's readable, but cluttered.

## Design

- [Systems design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/systems.md), section 4.

## Open questions

- ~~Render the Markdown in the browser, such as with a library like `react-markdown`, or tell the coordinator to write plain text?~~ Settled 2026-10-23 in chat: render it in the browser, so the agent's output stays as it is. With the "Raw" toggle from #125 off, replies show formatted. With it on, replies show the raw Markdown, so Joe sees exactly what the coordinator wrote.

## Do

- Show the coordinator's replies with their formatting when "Raw" is off, both as they stream in and in a resumed session (`web/src/chat-page.tsx`).
- Show the replies as raw Markdown when "Raw" is on.

## Done when

- With "Raw" off, a reply with bold labels and a numbered list shows them formatted, with no raw marks.
- With "Raw" on, the same reply shows its raw Markdown marks.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
